adaptive.title: Adaptive
adaptive.description: The Adaptive Sass mixin helps you set a max-width value on your container elements. It is useful when you want to apply adaptive design concepts to your responsive designs.

after.title: After
after.description: The After Sass mixin is an easy way to use the ::after CSS pseudo-element. You can insert text or design elements after the content of each selected element.

all-buttons.title: All Buttons
all-buttons.description: The All Buttons Sass mixin helps you target all the HTML button elements in the DOM, so you can easily apply your style rules.

all-text-inputs.title: All Text Inputs
all-text-inputs.description: The All Text Inputs Sass mixin helps you target all the text-based HTML input elements in the DOM, so you can easily apply your style rules.

antialias.title: Antialias
antialias.description: The Antialias Sass mixin provides smooth font rendering. It smooths fonts at the pixel level and prevents subpixel rendering.

aspect-ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect-ratio.description: The Aspect Ratio Sass mixin holds an element to the ratio you give it, and adds what the CSS aspect-ratio property alone leaves out. It replaces the Ratio Box and Responsive Video mixins.

background-dots.title: Background Dots
background-dots.description: The Background Dots Sass mixin allows you to create stylish, colorful dotted background patterns (also known as polka dots).

background-image.title: Background Image
background-image.description: The Background Image Sass mixin allows you to apply the background-image CSS property to the selected elements.

background-stripes.title: Background Stripes
background-stripes.description: The Background Stripes Sass mixin allows you to create stylish and colorful background stripes using the repeating-linear-gradient CSS function. You can easily create colorful background lines that are difficult to create with vanilla CSS.

before.title: Before
before.description: The Before Sass mixin is an easy way to use the ::before CSS pseudo-element. You can insert text or design elements before the content of each selected element.

border-box.title: Border Box
border-box.description: The Border Box Sass mixin sets the box-sizing CSS property to border-box for the selected HTML elements.

border-radius.title: Border Radius
border-radius.description: The Border Radius Sass mixin helps you round the corners of a selected element using the border-radius CSS property. You can pass one value (with a unit) to style all the corners equally, or use the CSS shorthand to style each corner differently.

brand-logo.title: Brand Logo
brand-logo.description: The Brand Logo Sass mixin helps you create an SEO-friendly logo component for your brand's website using CSS best practices.

breakpoint.title: Breakpoint
breakpoint.description: The Breakpoint Sass mixin helps you create scalable media queries and breakpoints using the @media CSS at-rule in SCSS.

breakpointer.title: Breakpointer
breakpointer.description: The Breakpointer Sass mixin is a handy little tool that shows which breakpoint you are at, so you can write your styles for that specific device.

center.title: Center
center.description: The Center Sass mixin allows you to center selected elements on both the horizontal and vertical axes using absolute positioning in CSS and Sass.

circle.title: Circle
circle.description: The Circle Sass mixin helps you create a perfect circle shape in CSS and Sass.

clearfix.title: Clearfix
clearfix.description: The Clearfix Sass mixin helps you fix broken layouts caused by using the float CSS property.

columnizer.title: Columnizer
columnizer.description: The Columnizer Sass mixin helps you create beautiful, responsive, card-based design layouts in CSS and Sass.

container.title: Container
container.description: Marks an element as a query container, so container-query can ask about its width instead of the viewport's. The rule that asks has to sit on a descendant: an element is never matched by a @container rule reading its own container, and nothing warns you when it is not.

container-query.title: Container Query
container-query.description: A @container rule, taking the same argument shapes as breakpoint so the two read alike. Sizes may be a key from $map-for-breakpoints or a raw length, and a length is the common case because a container is usually narrower than the viewport. Nothing matches at all unless an ancestor was declared with the container mixin.

counter.title: Counter
counter.description: The Counter Sass mixin allows you to present your content in a listicle format using CSS counter properties. With Sass and Gerillass it is now very easy to create elements that count automatically.

ellipsis.title: Ellipsis
ellipsis.description: The Ellipsis Sass mixin helps you trim text and add an ellipsis at the end of it using the CSS text-overflow property.

escape-to-parent.title: Escape to Parent
escape-to-parent.description: The Escape to Parent Sass mixin allows you to escape to the parent element and use multiple class or id selectors with it.

except.title: Except
except.description: The Except Sass mixin helps you apply style changes to every element in a list except the ones you choose. It uses the :not() CSS pseudo-class.

font-face.title: Font Face
font-face.description: The Font Face Sass mixin helps you generate a cross-browser compatible @font-face CSS at-rule in CSS and SCSS.

hide.title: Hide
hide.description: You can improve web accessibility by hiding elements with the Hide Sass mixin. It hides content visually on a web page while keeping it accessible to assistive technologies such as screen readers.

line-clamp.title: Line Clamp
line-clamp.description: Truncates text after a number of lines, where ellipsis truncates one. It emits five declarations rather than one because -webkit-line-clamp does nothing on its own: without display: -webkit-box or without -webkit-box-orient: vertical the text is not clamped at all and nothing warns you, and without overflow: hidden the clamped text spills out below the box. The unprefixed line-clamp is emitted too, for when it becomes Baseline.

linear-gradient.title: Linear Gradient
linear-gradient.description: The Linear Gradient Sass mixin helps you generate colorful CSS gradients and combine them with image and text elements. This way, you can create beautiful page components.

loadify.title: Loadify
loadify.description: Loadify Sass mixin is a handy tool that helps you make a page element load with a smooth fade-in effect while the page is loading. It also allows you to create smooth image loading effects.

only.title: Only
only.description: The Only Sass mixin helps you target elements based on their position among siblings of the same type (tag name). This mixin uses the :first-of-type, :last-of-type, and :nth-of-type CSS pseudo-classes.

placeholder.title: Placeholder
placeholder.description: The Placeholder Sass mixin helps you style the placeholder text in an input or textarea element and generate cross-browser compatible CSS code.

placeholder-shown.title: Placeholder Shown
placeholder-shown.description: The Placeholder Shown Sass mixin helps you style an input or textarea element that is currently displaying placeholder text, using the :placeholder-shown CSS pseudo-class.

position.title: Position
position.description: The Position Sass mixin provides a one-line method to quickly set both the position and the offset properties of a selected element.

radial-gradient.title: Radial Gradient
radial-gradient.description: The Radial Gradient Sass mixin helps you generate beautiful radial CSS gradients. It uses the radial-gradient CSS function.

remove.title: Remove
remove.description: The Remove Sass mixin helps you set the display CSS property of an element to none. It combines that with CSS media queries to show or hide an element in the document flow at different device widths.

reset-css.title: Reset CSS
reset-css.description: The Reset CSS Sass mixin (also known as CSS Reset) helps you reset the browser default styles of all HTML elements to a consistent baseline.

reset-figure.title: Reset Figure
reset-figure.description: The Reset Figure Sass mixin helps you reset the margin values of figure elements to zero and make the img element inside them responsive.

resizable.title: Resizable
resizable.description: The Resizable Sass mixin helps you make an element resizable in both the horizontal and vertical directions.

responsive-image.title: Responsive Image
responsive-image.description: The Responsive Image Sass mixin helps you make images responsive and change the default display CSS property value from inline to block, which removes the extra space below them.

scissors.title: Scissors
scissors.description: The Scissors Sass mixin helps you cut off the corners of an element. It provides an easy one-line method to set the size of the cut and choose the corners you want to apply it to.

screen-agent.title: Screen Agent
screen-agent.description: The Screen Agent Sass mixin helps you target elements based on different screen resolutions.

sizer.title: Sizer
sizer.description: The Sizer Sass mixin helps you size elements with one statement (or two). Size elements or create squares and rectangles very easily.

smartphone.title: Smartphone
smartphone.description: There will be times when you need to style elements for one particular smartphone model only. The Smartphone Sass mixin helps you do that.

sprite.title: Sprite
sprite.description: The Sprite Sass mixin helps you apply background images to the selected elements using the CSS sprite technique.

stretched-link.title: Stretched Link
stretched-link.description: The Stretched Link Sass mixin helps you make any HTML element clickable by stretching a nested link across its entire area.

tablet.title: Tablet
tablet.description: There will be times when you need to style elements for one particular tablet model only. The Tablet Sass mixin helps you do that.

text-gradient.title: Text Gradient
text-gradient.description: The Text Gradient Sass mixin (also known as CSS Gradient Text) helps you add a gradient overlay to a text element. It provides a one-line method to set the direction of the gradient line, the color values, and the color stop positions very easily.

text-image.title: Text Image
text-image.description: The Text Image Sass mixin helps you clip the background image of a selected element to the shape of its foreground text.

text-selection.title: Text Selection
text-selection.description: The Text Selection Sass mixin helps you style the portion of text (or an element) that a user has selected.

text-shadow.title: Text Shadow
text-shadow.description: The Text Shadow Sass mixin helps you add shadows to text elements. It accepts a comma separated list of shadows, or a single shadow value that can optionally be multiplied. It provides an easy one-line method.

text-stroke.title: Text Stroke
text-stroke.description: The Text Stroke Sass mixin helps you add a stroke to a text element and style it very easily.

triangle.title: Triangle
triangle.description: The Triangle Sass mixin helps you generate triangles using the ::before or ::after CSS pseudo-elements.
